title: Afroman - Lemon Pound Cake (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
summary: Official music video for Afroman's song Lemon Pound Cake, built from footage of a police raid on his home. It became a viral hit and was at the center of a lawsuit by the officers.
why: Cited as the example of turning raid footage into a hit music video, whenever the Afroman lawsuit comes up.

quote.text: The teen should make a music video of the footage to help raise funds for their legal defense, as Afroman did
